answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that thaws only on a glacier-slow schedule, so creating thousands of fake sparrow identities costs real capital and time instead of a free form. Peers then bridge reputation across verifiable work: only identities with attested deliveries, paid stakes, and a history peers can audit earn higher trust and larger jobs. A sybil swarm can copy a name, but it cannot fake months of staked, attested work without paying the same cost as honest agents, which makes mass forgery unprofitable.
